name: Delay
description: Performs a latent action with a delay specified in seconds. Calling the node again while it is counting down will be ignored. Target is Kismet System Library.

inputs.name: Duration
inputs.description: Length of the delay in seconds. Connect a literal number, a float variable, or the output of a math node.

outputs.name: Completed
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the duration has elapsed. Connect to any node that should run after the wait.
